title: RecipePlus
description: Adds A Ton Of New Recipes That Unlocks You Things That Was So Annoying Because It Was Uncraftable.
body:
New Recipes For Everything You Dreamed To Have A Recipe! Only Stuff That Needed Recipe Were Added, Not Recipes For Anything.
Recipes:
- -Chainmail Armor
- -Totem Of Undying
- -Lead
- -Leather
- -Saddle
- -Experience Bottle (XP Bottle)
- -Mobs Heads (Zombie | Skeleton | Creeper)
- -All Kinds Of Horse Armor
- -Slime Ball

No More Need To Travel Around The World Searching For A Single Thing To Make One Thing That Wasn't Worth The Time You Spent Traveling. 

\*/ If you find any bugs, had any improvements ideas, please let me know in the comments \*/
